name: Iconify Field
description: Provides a field type, icon-picker widget and SVG formatter for Iconify icons.

suggests.drupal/ckeditor5: Required by the bundled iconify_field_ckeditor submodule (icons in CKEditor 5 body text).
suggests.drupal/graphql_compose: Enables the bundled GraphQLCompose plugin that exposes the icon field as a String in the GraphQL schema.
suggests.drupal/single_content_sync: Enables the bundled SingleContentSync processor for import/export of icon field values.

provides_plugin_types: GraphQLCompose field type: iconify_field_icon (optional, requires graphql_compose)
SingleContentSync field processor: iconify_field_icon (optional, requires single_content_sync)
project_description: The Iconify Field module for Drupal lets you add SVG icons to any content, backed by the Iconify icon sets. It provides a new field type for selecting one or more icons from any Iconify collection, an icon-picker widget with a modal search UI, and a formatter that renders the chosen icon as inline SVG on the frontend with no client-side JavaScript required. Icons are read from the iconify/json Composer package installed on disk (via Iconify\IconsJSON\Finder), not from Iconify's public API, so rendering works offline and makes no third-party requests. Helpers include an iconify_field() Twig function for embedding a single icon in a template, a reusable iconify_field form element for custom forms, and a JSON API for listing collections and icons. A separate iconify_field_ckeditor submodule adds a CKEditor 5 plugin so content editors can drop icons into body text.
